mentions.name: HTTPState
mentions.description: A minimal, reactive, real-time state layer over HTTP. Each state is addressed by a UUID (max 128 bytes) and read/written via a simple GET/POST API or client libraries in 8 languages, enabling instant data sync across apps, devices, and services. Open source under a permissive license, it supports use cases like adding pub/sub communication, streaming sensor data to web/mobile UIs, persisting state across app runs, and syncing state across app instances, with planned features such as SMS/email updates, CAS-style optimistic concurrency, an iOS widget client, API keys, and a PostgreSQL extension.
mentions.problem: Adding real-time communication and state sync across apps, devices, or services is made as easy as one or two lines of code, without acting as a storage layer.
mentions.audience: Developers building apps, devices, or services who need quick real-time state synchronization and pub/sub-style communication, including embedded device users (C/C++ and MicroPython clients are on the roadmap).
